title: Requester Details Object
description: Schema for validating the Requester Details column JSON object structure in FOCUS datasets

Name.description: Readable display name for the principal identified by Principal ID

Email.description: Email address associated with the principal identified by Principal ID

Type.description: The kind of principal identified by Principal ID (e.g., User, Service Account, Application)

Credential.description: The credential identified by Credential ID

Id.description: The value of Credential ID for the credential described by this object

Type.description: The kind of credential identified by Credential ID (e.g., API Key, Session, Delegated Role)

Name.description: Readable display name for the credential identified by Credential ID

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format

Custom data generator-defined top-level properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format. A property whose value is an object may describe a further level of the requester, using the same Id, Type, and Name entries as the Credential object.
